description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for applying 'git apply' in reverse, testing various scenarios including setup, applying patches forward and reverse, handling of binary patches, and whitespace errors. It harnesses the 'test-lib.sh' library and uses git commands to create and manipulate repositories and patches.

methods.description: Checks that the given diff output is empty.
